parameters.jsCode: const candidate=$('Expand Deduplicated Candidates').item.json;const response=$json||{};const status=Number(response.statusCode||response.status||(response.error?599:200));const headers=response.headers||{};const contentType=String(headers['content-type']||headers['Content-Type']||'').toLowerCase();const raw=typeof response.body==='string'?response.body:'';const isPdf=contentType.includes('application/pdf')||/\.pdf(?:$|\?)/i.test(candidate.official_url);const text=isPdf?'':raw.replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,' ').replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/ | /gi,' ').replace(/&/gi,'&').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const truncated=text.length>50000;const officialText=text.slice(0,50000);const ready=status<400&&!isPdf&&officialText.length>=100;return {json:{...candidate,official_text:officialText,official_fetch_status:status,official_content_type:contentType||null,document_type:isPdf?'pdf':'official_announcement',pdf_requires_extraction:isPdf,text_truncated:truncated,analysis_ready:ready,fetch_warning:ready?null:(isPdf?'pdf_requires_extraction':status>=400?'fetch_failed':'missing_document')}};

const base=$('Validate Unverified Package').item.json;const response=$json||{};const body=response.body??response;return {json:{ok:!body.error&&Number(response.statusCode||0)<400,response:body,usage:base.usage||{},candidate_id:base.candidate_id}};

const items=$input.all();let accepted=0,inserted=0,duplicates=0,rejected=0,errors=0,searchCalls=0,modelCalls=0,promptTokens=0,completionTokens=0,totalTokens=0;for(const item of items){const row=item.json||{};const r=row.response||{};if(!row.ok){errors++;}accepted+=Number(r.accepted||0);inserted+=Number(r.inserted||0);duplicates+=Number(r.duplicates||0);rejected+=(r.rejected||[]).length;searchCalls+=Number(row.usage?.search_calls||0);modelCalls+=Number(row.usage?.model_calls||0);promptTokens+=Number(row.usage?.prompt_tokens||0);completionTokens+=Number(row.usage?.completion_tokens||0);totalTokens+=Number(row.usage?.total_tokens||0);}return [{json:{stage:'completed',responses:items.length,accepted,inserted,duplicates,rejected,errors,usage:{search_calls:searchCalls,model_calls:modelCalls,prompt_tokens:promptTokens,completion_tokens:completionTokens,total_tokens:totalTokens},workflow_execution_id:$execution.id,completed_at:new Date().toISOString(),note:'Green nodes are not publication proof; cases remain unverified until review.'}}];
